parsed.internal_thinking: Jimmy is offering 1 Wood for 1 Wheat. Looking at my resources, I have 1 Wood, 1 Wheat, and 2 Sheep. To build a settlement at Node 33 (which I've reached with my roads), I need 1 Wood, 1 Brick, 1 Wheat, and 1 Sheep. Accepting this trade would give me 2 Wood but leave me with 0 Wheat. Since I already have 1 Wood and my main bottleneck is Brick (especially with the robber on my only Brick hex, Hex 5), giving away my only Wheat for a second Wood doesn't move me closer to a settlement. I need to keep the Wheat for the eventual settlement build. Jimmy is also a competitor and has a hidden development card, so I shouldn't give him resources he specifically asks for unless it clearly completes a build for me.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Jimmy's Wood for Wheat trade. I have enough Wood for now but zero Brick and only one Wheat. I need to prioritize getting Brick while the robber is on Hex 5.
parsed.say_outloud: ג'ימי, אני מעריכה את ההצעה וזה באמת יותר הוגן מהניסיונות של קלוד, אבל אני פשוט לא יכולה לוותר על החיטה האחרונה שלי כרגע. אני תקועה בלי טיט בגלל השודד, אז אני חייבת לשמור על מה שיש לי.
